title: Apple Introduces New iPad Mini Featuring OLED Display
excerpt: Apple has revealed an updated iPad Mini with an 8.5-inch OLED screen, starting at $699 for the Wi-Fi model.
body_html:
Apple has announced a new version of the iPad Mini featuring a larger 8.5-inch OLED display. The company unveiled the updated tablet shortly before its upcoming Wednesday event.

The latest device measures 5.4mm in thickness, making it lighter and thinner than previous iterations. In terms of pricing, the Wi-Fi-only configuration starts at $699, while the model that includes both Wi-Fi and cellular connectivity is priced at $849.
